items.title: Dungeon Complete
items.description: Play or customize Reactor Station, a third-person action game with robot guards, a boss, inventory, upgrades and a PocketStation minigame. Choose C++, Blueprint or Lua for the game rules.

items.title: Six starters in three languages
items.description: Create Basic, Sample, Third Person, Platformer 2D, Dungeon or Dungeon Complete in C++, Blueprint or Lua. All three variants share the same scenes and assets. Lua gameplay compiles ahead of time to native C++ for PSX.

items.title: Gameplay actions and input contexts
items.description: Bind controller inputs to named actions. Let gameplay, menus and conversations take turns handling the same buttons through temporary contexts.

items.title: World interaction helpers
items.description: Place and extend reflected actors for examination, NPC dialogue, pickups, doors and switches in any of the three gameplay languages.

items.title: Dialogue widgets
items.description: Author conversations with lines, choices, conditions and actions. Present them through a UIActor derived from DialoguePresenter.

items.title: Shared character movement and animation
items.description: Drive 2D and 3D character movement with shared motors and use gameplay state to select animation. The starter languages use the same underlying components.

items.title: Gameplay camera rigs
items.description: Configure camera follow and aiming through shared rigs and projection helpers.

items.title: Health helpers
items.description: Apply damage and healing with shared, bounded health arithmetic through HealthState and HealthLibrary.

items.title: Pooled projectiles
items.description: Fire and update projectiles from a bounded pool backed by the 3D collision system.

items.title: Shared 3D query context
items.description: Use a reflected component to perform 3D gameplay queries through the existing collision backend.
